set.body: Child of bd-01M35JG7DXD7NSEE4WVEKT3CSF per T1. Acceptance: an edition is an ordered part table; global request ordinals map to (part, local ordinal) through the v2 manifest; output gives per-part loci plus observed coverage (sampled ordinals, PTS, density), with unsampled spans as unavailable gaps; the disk loader reads the frames, request and caption envelopes, verifyOutcome runs over the bytes, and a missing receipt refuses. Depends on AC4-S1.
set.title: [media] AC4-S2: multi-part caption package + disk loader + per-part observed coverage (child of bd-01M35JG7DXD7NSEE4WVEKT3CSF)
